records.name: Papyrus 52 (P52)
records.date_estimate: 2nd century CE; the exact dating is debated and proposals extend into the 3rd century
records.date_basis: Palaeography; not an exact calendar date
records.holding_institution: John Rylands Research Institute and Library, Manchester
records.caution: Do not call it definitively the earliest manuscript without explaining dating uncertainty.

records.name: Papyrus 46 (P46)
records.contents: Pauline writings; surviving manuscript is incomplete
records.holding_institution: Chester Beatty Library, Dublin, with additional leaves at University of Michigan
records.caution: Do not imply that every Pauline writing or every verse survives in this codex.

records.name: Papyrus 66 (P66)
records.condition: Approximately 75 identifiable papyrus folios and numerous fragments
records.caution: The catalogue describes a fragmentary surviving manuscript, not a complete copy.

records.name: Papyrus 75 (P75) / Papyrus Bodmer XIV–XV
records.date_estimate: Often placed around the early 3rd century; dating discussions vary
records.contents: Substantial portions of Luke and John
records.condition: Incomplete; about half the text of each Gospel survives in satisfactory condition according to the cited Vatican study
records.caution: The date is an estimate, not a precise year; discovery and provenance details are not fully certain.

records.name: Codex Sinaiticus
records.date_estimate: Generally dated to the 4th century; a published reassessment argues a possible range from early 4th to early 5th century
records.contents: Extensive portions of Greek Hebrew Scriptures and Apostolic Writings; the project index lists surviving material from 2 Esdras, Esther, Tobit, Judith, 1 Maccabees, 4 Maccabees, Wisdom of Solomon, and Sirach among other books. Individual coverage is incomplete.
records.holding_institution: British Library; Leipzig University Library; National Library of Russia; Saint Catherine's Monastery
records.status: metadata catalogued; electronic transcription source located; transcription and images not yet imported
records.caution: Do not present the middle of the 4th century as an exact date; portions are held by multiple institutions. The project's electronic transcription has a separate CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 licence and is not yet bundled in this archive.

digital_transcription_source.title: Codex Sinaiticus Project electronic transcription
digital_transcription_source.version: Project website v1.05; repository also provides a later v1.94 XML file
digital_transcription_source.format: TEI-based XML with page, column, line, verse, correction and marginal-text markup
digital_transcription_source.attribution: The Codex Sinaiticus Project, www.codexsinaiticus.org; XML transcription maintained in the itsee-birmingham/codex-sinaiticus repository
digital_transcription_source.status: source located; text not yet imported into this archive
digital_transcription_source.caution: Non-commercial and share-alike terms apply to the transcription. Preserve the manuscript's corrections, page/column/line coordinates and editorial markup when importing. Do not treat the transcription as a modern critical edition.

records.name: Codex Vaticanus (Vat.gr.1209)
records.date_estimate: 4th century CE according to the Vatican Library catalogue
records.contents: The Vatican Library catalogue lists extensive Hebrew Scripture and Apostolic Writings contents, including the four Gospels, Acts, letters, and Revelation
records.condition: Surviving codex; catalogue pagination and contents must be checked passage by passage
records.caution: Vatican digital images are stated to be for personal use or study; publication rights require permission from the Library.

catalog_policy: Metadata records are not transcriptions. A manuscript passage is not available in-app until the exact folio/page, image rights, transcription source, and reading have been verified. Dates are estimates and must retain uncertainty.
